source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with layered spring mountains, misty water, small architectural clusters, bridges, rocky shores, and foreground pines rendered in ink linework with pale ochre and green washes. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif selection.

motifs.name: central_spring_mountain
motifs.description: The large central mountain mass rising behind the lake, including its rounded summit, layered ridges, gullies, scrubby tree bands, dark conifer dots, and pale ochre-green washes. Isolate the mountain form and attached wooded slopes, excluding the calligraphy at upper left and seals at upper right.
must_preserve: rounded summit silhouette with broken ink contour lines
layered cun-style rock texture and dry-brush striations
dark dotted conifer clusters along ridgelines
pale ochre and green wash transitions
small mist-softened gaps between ridges

motifs.name: right_misty_peaks
motifs.description: The distant mountain chain on the upper right, with pale peaks emerging from white mist and a low dark ridge line crossing the water. Isolate the atmospheric peaks and cloud-water edges without including the red seals.
must_preserve: soft gray-green wash peaks
faded mist edges around mountain bases
low dark ink ridge silhouettes
subtle layered distance recession
open white cloud-water spaces

motifs.name: midground_lakeside_hamlet
motifs.description: Small buildings and pavilions nestled among trees on the central-to-right midground shore, including rooflines, groves, footpaths, nearby low hills, and small waterside details. Exclude the larger foreground pine grove.
must_preserve: tiny angular roof geometry
fine vertical tree trunks and dotted foliage
thin shoreline and path linework
rocky hill texture around the houses
light ochre washes on banks and slopes

motifs.name: central_lake_mist_surface
motifs.description: The broad open lake and mist field occupying the middle-left of the painting, with horizontal water washes, faint shorelines, and blank atmospheric space between foreground and distant hills. Isolate only the water and mist surface, avoiding surrounding cliffs and buildings as much as possible.
must_preserve: horizontal pale ink wash bands
soft disappearing shoreline strokes
large reserved blank water areas
misty transitions into distant banks
subtle ochre staining along water edges

motifs.name: left_cliff_lone_pine
motifs.description: The left mid-foreground rocky promontory with a single leaning pine growing from its top edge, including the cliff face, dark moss dots, root-like lines, and pine needles. Exclude the nearby hut to the right.
must_preserve: leaning pine trunk and spreading needle clusters
jagged cliff outline
dark moss-dot texture down the rock face
dry-brush rock wrinkles
pale ochre wash on the stone ledges

motifs.name: rock_sheltered_hut
motifs.description: A small hut or pavilion tucked between boulders in the lower-middle left, with a simple pitched roof, posts, enclosing rocks, bamboo-like stalks, and nearby shrubs. Keep the architecture and immediate rocky shelter only.
must_preserve: thin angular roof outline
short vertical support posts
surrounding rounded boulder contours
slender bamboo or reed strokes behind the hut
small dark foliage dots and pale ground wash

motifs.name: arched_bridge_stream
motifs.description: The low arched bridge crossing a narrow stream in the lower center, including bridge railings, support posts, stream banks, nearby rocks, and sparse grasses. Exclude the tall foreground pines to the right except where their edges overlap minimally.
must_preserve: curved bridge deck and fine rail lines
vertical bridge supports reflected in water
ink-outlined stream banks
small rounded rocks at both ends
delicate grass and shrub strokes along the water

motifs.name: right_foreground_pine_grove
motifs.description: The prominent right foreground grove of tall pines growing on steep textured hillsides, including the pale trunks, branching structure, dense needle clusters, surrounding moss-dotted slopes, and adjacent rock faces. Isolate the tree grove and supporting hillside, avoiding the lower red seal.
must_preserve: tall pale pine trunks with dark contour lines
radiating needle clusters on layered branches
dense moss-dot patterns on the slopes
steep rock face texture and contour strokes
ochre-green washes separating hills, trunks, and foliage

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
